documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in consulting operations. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in consulting operations who is experiencing workflow issues after a configuration change. They explicitly stated that this is a support incident and requested that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The current stage is 'customer' with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east'.

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.
